source_plan.waveform: four separate train snippets concatenated and cyclically repeated
source_plan.receiver_label: unknown until independently correlated and reviewed

legacy_envelope.alignment_method: median best lag in first seven during-TX windows; apply unchanged to last eight and both TX-off controls
legacy_envelope.interpretation: exploratory source-specific RF link evidence, not model accuracy or independent RF admission

v4_source.interpretation: conditional phase-null stopped control and finite searched source contrast; not live RF qualification

stopped_phase_null.null_assumption: independent uniform non-DC Fourier phases conditional on amplitudes

continuity_summary.interpretation: fixed raw-window powers and adjacent repetition only; no new fit or qualification
